title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 69
description: Ten questions on Psalms 69: a cry from deep waters, reproach for God's sake, vinegar for thirst and a song of praise.

questions.text: In verse 1, how high does the speaker say the waters have come?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says: "Save me, God, for the waters have come up to my neck!"

questions.text: What does the speaker say those who hate him without a cause are more than?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says those who hate him without a cause are more than the hairs of his head.

questions.text: To whom has the speaker become a stranger?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says he has become a stranger to his brothers, an alien to his mother's children.

questions.text: What does the speaker say consumes him?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 says: "For the zeal of your house consumes me."

questions.text: What did the speaker become to them when he made sackcloth his clothing?
questions.explanation: Verse 11 says that when he made sackcloth his clothing, he became a byword to them.

questions.text: Whose song does the speaker say he has become?
questions.explanation: Verse 12 says those who sit in the gate talk about him, and he is the song of the drunkards.

questions.text: What was the speaker given to drink in his thirst?
questions.explanation: Verse 21 says that in his thirst they gave him vinegar to drink.

questions.text: Out of what does the speaker ask that his enemies be blotted out?
questions.explanation: Verse 28 says: "Let them be blotted out of the book of life, and not be written with the righteous."

questions.text: What does the speaker say his song of praise will please Yahweh better than?
questions.explanation: Verses 30-31 say his praise and thanksgiving will please Yahweh better than an ox, or a bull that has horns and hoofs.

questions.text: Whose cities does verse 35 say God will build?
questions.explanation: Verse 35 says God will save Zion and build the cities of Judah.
